Agencies at the core

Trio works when all three work together.

Every program on Trio runs on three partners: the client, the MSP, and the agency. Agencies aren't on the outside of that relationship. You're one of its cores, a stakeholder whose decisions shape every placement and whose input shapes where Trio goes next.

Questions agencies ask

Something not covered here? The Agency Experience team is a message away.

Do I need a new login or a new version of Trio?

No. Submission Evaluator, Job Competition Scorer and Job Q&A are available in your existing Trio account. Log in and they're there.

Who can connect with the Agency Experience team?

Your agency can, as a Trio agency partner. Share your team and priorities, then pick a time on Gary's calendar.

Will the webinar be recorded?

Yes. The webinar will be recorded and distributed after the live session.

Who do I contact with a question about my account?

Email info@triowfs.com with any questions about your account.
